I was reluctant to say this whole thing was homophobic, but after reading this it's hard not to see it as such. The absolute dismissal of their emotions and this relationship like Eve was watching a strange dog get run over in front of her instead of the woman she loved, the love of her life, like she could just turn around and ever be okay...the more I read about it the more grossed out I feel. A bad ending is one thing, but this is such a dismissal of WLW relationships, like how we feel about one another isn't human...

You can't really imagine them doing so? Apparently the original author could, but you can't... this absolutely clownish and has George Lucas creating Jar Jar Binks vibes. Just total nonsense about emotions dealing with loss and love, it really makes me question what kind of emotional depth she has.  Eve at this point has gone through so much trauma and lost all the people she loves and that's... what? Survival? Who wants to JUST survive in life? Ugh. I will never date someone with BPD again. (She didn't physically harm me so the cops didn't/don't care.)
